description: Input accepted by public assignment lifecycle operations that prepare handoff packets, import returns, admit or reject results, integrate admitted work, and record lifecycle maintenance actions.

configuration_revision.description: Current source-resolved execution configuration offer revision. Only an intention to select, never authority to replace an existing assignment.

configuration_id.description: One eligible configuration from the paired revision; target, transport and adapter-owned topology stay bound together.

admission_status.description: Reviewer decision recorded for an imported assignment return.

artifact_ref.description: Path or durable reference to a lifecycle artifact, such as an export packet or imported return record.

assignment_id.description: Stable Planning assignment identifier for the delegated run.

assignment_ref.description: Alias for planning_assignment_ref for hosts that already expose assignment refs.

assignment_revision.description: Current assignment authority revision that the lifecycle operation is scoped to.

dry_run.description: Whether to compute the lifecycle transition without applying local artifact writes.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for temporary overrides or lifecycle decisions.

planning_assignment_ref.description: Optional repo-relative checked-in Planning assignment ref; omitted uses .agentic-workspace/planning/assignments/<assignment-id>.assignment.json.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for rejection, repair, reassignment, cleanup, close, or override actions.

return_id.description: Stable identifier for a returned assignment result packet.

return_json.description: Serialized worker return payload awaiting admission.

return_file.description: Repo-contained UTF-8 file holding one serialized worker return payload awaiting admission; mutually exclusive with return_json.

review_result_json.description: Serialized producer-owned independent-review result envelope to admit through assignment.admit.

review_result_ref.description: Repo-relative path to a producer-owned independent-review result envelope.

host_result_ref.description: Opaque host/adapter independent-review result ref to import and admit.

required_mode.description: Required separation mode for independent-review admission.

changed.description: Changed paths whose independent-review scope must match the admitted result.

changed_paths.description: Changed paths whose independent-review scope must match the admitted result.

run_id.description: Stable assignment run identifier used for local lifecycle artifact storage.

scope.description: Bounded scope for reassignment, repair, cleanup, close, or override records.

target.description: Target repository path for the lifecycle operation.

task.description: Full human intent bound into the canonical assignment identity.

target_name.description: Named target or worker lane that receives the assignment packet.

task_proof_receipt_ref.description: Repo-relative AW proof receipt whose assignment obligation must match the run being closed.

transport.description: Transport channel used for the assignment packet or returned result; manual prepares a handoff, while a configuration-authorized internal or CLI route executes the sealed packet through its target adapter.

title: Assignment lifecycle operation input
